reviews.rationale: Turn 1 supplies and echoes the blue box and top shelf. Turn 6 tests and correctly recalls the location; later references to boxes do not repeat it.
Turn 1 supplies and echoes the riverside preference and avoidance of steep steps. Turn 4 tests those constraints; mentioning steps in the probe does not restate the preference.
Turn 1 supplies and echoes the programme name and Wednesday commitment. The reminder in turn 5 tests both; later references to the programme do not repeat them.
Theo’s silver gloves are supplied and echoed in turn 1 and tested in turn 6. Later repetitions of the user's scarf colour do not repeat Theo’s item.
Turn 1 supplies the available pan and lack of an oven and proposes pan-toasting. Turn 5 tests and recalls the equipment and suitable method.
Turn 1 supplies and echoes the red clock meeting point. Later terminal references provide context but do not repeat the landmark, which turn 6 tests.
Turn 2 places the receipt in the desk drawer, reinforcing its separate location. Turn 5 tests whether it belongs in the bag and recalls the drawer.
Turn 1 supplies and echoes the instruction to keep the study closed. Turn 5 tests that instruction; its reference to the study door does not restate the rule.
Turn 3 explicitly echoes that wanting a repair does not authorise work. Turn 5 tests the permission boundary, but only one complete turn intervenes, not the claimed two.
Turn 1 supplies and echoes AH-na. Later mentions of Ana do not repeat her pronunciation, which turn 6 directly tests.
